Hana Park: Heads-up — during q2b-embed-1 bring-up I noticed weird false positives on the noisy_queries holdout. recall@10 dropped from ~0.84 -> 0.72 on the probe set. Sharing a quick sample and asking for triage.

Samir Patel: Can you paste the probe sample and the eval run id? Did the job use L2 or cosine? Was post-normalize applied?

Hana Park: run id: embed-audit/20250314/rc3 (ran yesterday). Metric: cosine, no post-normalize. Example short query that triggered FP: "What's the capital of France?" matched to a legal doc paragraph about "capital contributions". Short queries seem to get noisy hits.

Miguel Torres: hmm that's odd. I re-ran a quick local eval with seed=42 on the same run artifacts and got recall@10=0.71, mAP=0.62. High FP rate for short queries. Could be subword/tokenization or quantization effects.

Lee Wong: Two quick hypotheses: 1) missing post-normalization before nearest-neighbor (cosine vs inner product) 2) int8 per-tensor quantization changed scale in last layers. q2b-embed-1 export used ONNX int8 (per-tensor) for footprint tests?

Hana Park: yes the export used ONNX int8 per-tensor — we were testing smaller footprints. If quantization messed with vector angles that could explain cosine degradation.

Samir Patel: quick local test: apply L2-normalize and search with inner product. Snippet I used: ```python
vecs = np.load('embeddings.npy')
vecs = vecs / np.linalg.norm(vecs, axis=1, keepdims=True)
index = faiss.IndexFlatIP(vecs.shape[1])
index.add(vecs)
D, I = index.search(vecs_query, k=10)
```

eval-bot: job embed-audit/20250315/retest finished: recall@10=0.83 (+0.12), mAP=0.71, false_positive_rate_short=0.09. Notes: post-normalize recovered most short-query recall; per-tensor int8 still slightly worse than fp16 baseline on long docs. Link: <https://console.redwood/models/q2b-embed-1/audit|audit page>.

Miguel Torres: great signal. Let's do a controlled sweep: int8(per-tensor) vs int8(per-channel) vs fp16, each with and without post-normalize. Also include noisy-queries subset (typos, punctuation, short Qs). I'll schedule a 50k-sample sweep across the holdout.

Hana Park: please also add a tiny probe for tokenization edge-cases (emojis, dates, legal abbreviations) — I can craft 3k of those. If per-tensor INT8 is culprit we should add a clear note in the model-card and in the export checklist.

Lee Wong: Agreed. Additionally add silhouette score and cluster-purity( top-1 ) checks, and compute "embed drift delta" vs our current baseline. If drift > 0.03 for short-queries we flag. I'll add to the eval checklist.

Samir Patel: I'll open a small PR to default to post-normalize in the embed-serving config for q2b-embed-1 on staging and add a flag to toggle pre/post normalize for A/B.

Hana Park: Thanks all. Action items: Miguel schedule the sweep; Samir PR to staging; Lee add evals and thresholds; Hana update model-card draft with export caveat. :thumbsup:

(quick note: leaving this thread pinned to the channel for follow-ups)
